knownCaveats: Name any stateful/order-dependent case here, e.g.: 'auth/verify-otp/01 depends on auth/request-otp/01 having run first for the same identifier.'

publish.notes: Where testing-api writes the package (the collection with its environments, Bruno: one zip) after each run. One of four targets: '1password' (one vault item, shared with the team, after the user's yes), 'local' (the folder in 'localFolder', written without asking), '1password+local' (both), 'confluence' (the collection WITHOUT environments on the page in the 'confluence' block, after the user's yes and a secret scan, and the package in 'localFolder'; not for insomnia). 'localFolder' is required for local, 1password+local and confluence, must not be inside a git repo, and keeps the previous package as .prev. Optional 'extraEnvironmentFiles' ([{name, sourcePath}]) are extra environment files added into the package, and 'envRefreshProcedure' a doc in <workDir>/config/ that refreshes their live values first. No other copy is kept, not even in the run folder.

confluence.notes: Only needed for api.publish.target 'confluence'; omit it otherwise. Environments never go to Confluence.

api.notes: 'client' is one of "bruno", "postman", "insomnia" and picks which testing-api adapter runs this collection — everything else in this block has the same meaning regardless of client. 'defaultEnvironment' is used by plain runs when no staging-like branch can be resolved; 'ticketEnvironment' (optional) is the shared environment ticket mode proposes and asks the user to confirm before each run; without it, ticket mode asks which environment to use. Both are names of the collection's environment files. For Postman, collectionPath should point at a directory containing both the *.postman_collection.json file and an environments/ folder of *.postman_environment.json files, mirroring Bruno's shape.

notes: This block can live in the same file as the app-with-ui shape if one product has both a UI and an API collection.
